title: Job openings at Standard Specialist Hospital
content:
Standard Specialist Hospital is a 24-hour secondary services hospital in the heart of Kano State that provides high-quality healthcare services.

We are recruiting to fill the following positions below: 

1.) Registered Midwife 

Job Location: Tarauni, Kano

Employment Type: Full-time
Department: Maternity/Labour Ward
Reports To: Matron / Head of Nursing Services

Job Summary
     

            
    




	The Registered Midwife is responsible for providing safe, evidence-based, compassionate, and high-quality care to women during pregnancy, labour, childbirth, and the postnatal period.
	The Midwife also provides essential newborn care, health education, family planning counselling, and supports the multidisciplinary healthcare team in promoting maternal and child health.


Key Responsibilities
Antenatal Care:


	Conduct comprehensive antenatal assessments.
	Monitor maternal and fetal wellbeing.
	Identify high-risk pregnancies and promptly refer to the appropriate clinician.
	Provide antenatal health education on nutrition, birth preparedness, breastfeeding, danger signs, and newborn care.
	Administer prescribed medications and immunizations.


Labour and Delivery:


	Admit and assess women in labour.
	Monitor labour using the partograph.
	Conduct normal vaginal deliveries within the scope of practice.
	Recognize complications early and promptly notify the obstetrician.
	Assist in instrumental and Caesarean deliveries when required.
	Perform neonatal resuscitation where necessary.
	Ensure infection prevention and control measures are strictly followed.


Postnatal Care:


	Monitor mothers during the immediate postpartum period.
	Assess uterine involution, bleeding, pain, and recovery.
	Promote and support exclusive breastfeeding.
	Educate mothers on newborn care, hygiene, nutrition, family planning, and postnatal danger signs.
	Identify postpartum complications and initiate appropriate referrals.


Newborn Care:


	Perform immediate newborn assessment.
	Monitor newborn growth and wellbeing.
	Administer routine newborn medications and immunizations according to hospital protocols.
	Maintain accurate newborn documentation.
	Educate mothers on infant feeding, immunization schedules, and newborn danger signs.


Emergency Care:


	Respond promptly to obstetric emergencies.
	Participate in neonatal resuscitation.
	Assist in the management of postpartum haemorrhage, eclampsia, obstructed labour, and other obstetric emergencies.
	Maintain readiness of emergency equipment and medications.


Patient Education:


	Provide counselling on:
	
		Pregnancy care
		Family planning
		Breastfeeding
		Nutrition
		Personal hygiene
		Prevention of sexually transmitted infections
		Child immunization
	
	
	Encourage attendance at antenatal and postnatal clinics.


Documentation:


	Maintain accurate, timely, and confidential patient records.
	Complete labour, delivery, postnatal, and newborn documentation.
	Report incidents and adverse events according to hospital policy.


Infection Prevention and Quality Assurance:


	Adhere to infection prevention and control guidelines.
	Ensure proper sterilization of equipment.
	Participate in quality improvement activities and maternal death reviews.
	Comply with hospital safety standards and regulatory requirements.


Teamwork:


	Collaborate effectively with obstetricians, paediatricians, anaesthetists, nurses, laboratory personnel, pharmacists, and other healthcare professionals.
	Participate in ward rounds, clinical meetings, and multidisciplinary case reviews.
	Mentor junior staff and student midwives where assigned.


Professional Development:


	Maintain current registration and licence.
	Participate in continuing professional development (CPD).
	Keep up to date with evidence-based midwifery practices.
	Comply with the Code of Professional Conduct for Nurses and Midwives.


Qualifications


	Registered Midwife (RM).
	Current practising licence issued by the Nursing and Midwifery Council of Nigeria (NMCN).
	Additional certification in Basic Life Support (BLS) and Neonatal Resuscitation is an advantage.


Experience:


	Minimum of 1- 2 years of post-qualification clinical experience is preferred.
	Experience in a secondary or tertiary healthcare facility is an added advantage.


Required Skills:


	Excellent clinical and midwifery skills.
	Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
	Ability to remain calm during emergencies.
	Sound clinical judgement and decision-making.
	Compassionate and patient-centred approach.
	Good documentation and record-keeping skills.
	Ability to work independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team.
	Basic computer literacy.


Personal Attributes:


	Integrity and professionalism.
	Compassion and empathy.
	Emotional resilience.
	Attention to detail.
	Respect for patient confidentiality.
	Strong ethical standards.
	Good time management and organizational skills.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their application and copies of credentials to: [email protected] using using the Job Position as the subject of the mail.

 

 

2.) Night Shift Pharmacy Technician

Job Location: Kano
Employment Type: Full-time

Responsibilities


	Dispense medications under the supervision of the Pharmacist.
	Prepare and label medications accurately.
	Maintain proper inventory and stock records.
	Receive, store, and organize pharmaceutical supplies.
	Ensure compliance with hospital policies and pharmaceutical regulations.
	Provide courteous and professional service to patients and healthcare staff.
	Perform other pharmacy-related duties as assigned.


Requirements


	Possess an HND / OND with 1 - 2 years of work experience
	Registered Pharmacy Technician with the appropriate regulatory authority.
	Valid practicing licence.
	Good communication and interpersonal skills.
	Ability to work independently during night shifts.
	High level of integrity, attention to detail, and professionalism.
	Proficiency in basic computer applications.

	Ensure compliance with hospital policies and pharmaceutical regulations.
	Provide courteous and professional service to patients and healthcare staff.
	Perform other pharmacy-related duties as assigned.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their application, CV, copies of academic and professional credentials and a copy of a valid practicing licence to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the mail.

Automotive / Mechanical Engineering Professional Job at SAGLEV




        
    

        
        SAGLEV is a company that has been established to distribute, assemble, and manufacture (SKD/CKD/CB) vehicles across emerging markets. Providing affordable financing options for electric vehicles to compete with low-cost second-hand vehicles in the region.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Automotive / Mechanical Engineering Professional 

Job Location: Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Key Requirements
     

            
    




	Bachelor’s Degree / HND in Automotive Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a closely related field.
	Proven hands-on experience in both automotive manufacturing/vehicle assembly and vehicle servicing, maintenance, and repairs.
	Strong practical knowledge of vehicle systems, diagnostics, troubleshooting, repairs, and manufacturing processes.
	Experience in vehicle assembly, commissioning, inspection, quality control, or production operations.
	Experience with automotive electrical and electronic systems is an added advantage.
	Experience working with an Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) is highly desirable.
	EV/Hybrid vehicle experience is an added advantage.
	Experience in warranty diagnosis, technical reporting, job cards, and service documentation is an advantage.
	Strong technical troubleshooting and problem-solving abilities.
	Ability to read and interpret technical manuals, wiring diagrams, and engineering documentation.
	Strong communication, organisational, and teamwork skills.
	Ability to work independently with minimal supervision and perform effectively in a fast-paced automotive environment.
	Must be available to resume immediately.
	Candidates preferably resident in Lagos.


Important:


	We are looking for a senior, highly practical technician—not an entry-level mechanic or graduate trainee.
	Candidates must have practical experience in both automotive manufacturing/vehicle assembly and vehicle servicing/maintenance/repairs.
	Candidates who do not meet this requirement should not apply.
